create.title: Global direct beta nonsaddle signed-section and radial-BV bound
create.statement_tex: On the returned positive-a, positive-b endpoint-free beta terminal, put R=1+|alpha| and kappa=3/4+(a+b)/2<1. After forming the singular signed diagonal Cauchy logarithm before absolute values, the complete phase-removed section satisfies |P|<<log^C(2X)R^(kappa-2), |partial_L P|<<log^C(2X)R^(kappa-3), while its exact phase-conjugated logarithmic x derivative satisfies |Q|<<log^C(2X)R^(kappa-1), |partial_L Q|<<log^C(2X)R^(kappa-2), uniformly in both alpha signs, every actual index, finite physical section, and actual lambda. The x derivative is kept as [eta p(nu)-alpha p(L)]/(L-nu)=alpha[p(nu)-p(L)]/(L-nu)-p(nu)/2. Moving traces have the matching dyadic capacities and vanish in symmetric height exhaustion; the exact diagonal limit is smaller by two powers. On the accepted subordinate inner and outer supports, one L integration by parts is summable because kappa<1, both true outer boundary terms vanish, and the untouched h^(-r)q^(-p), scale, radial-BV, floor, star, character, collision, endpoint, routed-module, and external-factor ledger gives a physical O(X^(1/4)log^C(2X)) contribution. No saddle stationary numerator or global lambda^(-2) normalization is used.

Multiplication by m preserves the accepted Round-41 signed diagonal, off-diagonal, smooth, moving-trace, exact Morse-BV, entry, exit, and half-Fresnel bounds by Leibniz and finite linearity. Hence the repaired middle multipliers from M9-M1-beta-positive-line-subordinate-alpha-partition are covered exactly by the accepted fixed-ratio saddle/entry/exit theorem; their sum equals the full middle antecedent and leaves the total saddle coefficient unchanged. This creates no alpha connector because localization occurs after return to the positive line.
